scientific_integrity.finite_verification: 40 BFS shortest-host/uniqueness cases and 65472 explicit coverage tests. Finite evidence is separate from the proof.
scientific_integrity.proof_basis: Two forced-run lower bounds and exhaustive all-length target embeddings, plus reversal/complement symmetry.
scientific_integrity.provenance: No independent verification or external certification is asserted.

scientific_limitations: Only binary nonconstant forbidden patterns of length three and integer target lengths k>=3.
No claim for unary forbidden patterns, longer forbidden patterns, larger alphabets or unconstrained hosts.
Residual possibility of an unindexed or inaccessible equivalent; independent scientific audit not yet performed.
title: Unique shortest forbidden-subsequence covers for every nonconstant binary triple
